newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EBRD APPROVES 3 MLN MARK INVESTMENT INTO MAAPANK.
newsitem.headline: EBRD APPROVES 3 MLN MARK INVESTMENT INTO MAAPANK.

text.p: The Board of the European bank of Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) has given its final approval fpr a three million mark equity investment into unlisted Maapank, the EBRD said on Wednesday.
"We will invest three million marks in equity in Maapank," Jonathan Harfield, EBRD represenative to Estonia, told Reuters.
The investment is part of the EBRD's support for the six largest banks in Estonia.
"We have always said that there are six important banks in Estonia and the investment into Maapank is in line with this strategy," Hartfiled said.
The equity investment does not have any conditions, however in the long term the EBRD hopes the bank will be a traded stock.
"We hope that our investment will facilate a stock exchange listing in due course," he added.
Maapank is currently the sixth largest bank in Estonia with assets worth 1.1 billion kroons in March.
